title: Got me out of some kitchen trouble after I lost mine XD
text: Got me out of some kitchen trouble after I lost mine XD. I lost my older strainer so I was in desperate need of new ones. I was having a hard time finding new ones and they were super expensive at the store for whatever reason. I decided to look online and bought these ones. They arrived super fast and for a really good price as well as the amount I think they were worth it!

product_metadata.title: CHICHIC Set of 3 Stainless Steel Kitchen Fine Strainers Tea Fine Y Mesh Strainers Juice Egg Filter 3 Sieve Colander Sets Wire Filter Mesh for Tea Coffee Food Rice Vegetable with Handle
features: 2.76" mini strainer can be as tea strainer, coffee strainer, etc. Ideal size to sift small amounts of dried ingredients, spices, sifting flour, straining tea, kombucha, or sugar. Big enough to drain a single boiled egg, separate the pulp while collecting orange or lemon juice in a flash. It's perfect to infuse tea leaves or dried herbs
4.72" Ideal size strainer to sift thick, clumpy dry ingredients such as baby cereals, ground oatmeal, salt, spices and more. Perfect skimmer for fermented food or cheese

7.09" sieve will break compacted food into airy, uniform ingredient, also works great for sifting of any quantity of dry ingredients whether coarse or fine as sugar, confectioner's icing, cocoa powder, ground coffee beans and more
2 inch - 7inch different size strainer, perfect match for kitchen. Anti-rust and durable Stainless steel material, Easy to clean and store

Durable and high grade stainless steel mesh strainer won’t rust, corrode, bend or warp; it is a heavy duty tool with tough built and greater flexibility to deliver superior performance every single time
